verdicts.explanation: The paper's own MD (Methods 4.6, all runs at 353 K, 1.5 mol/kg Li+TFSI) gives 1.13×10-3 S/cm for the candidate CC(CNCCOCCOCCOC*)O*, so the material, value, unit, temperature and computational origin all match. The 79.85 °C conversion is just 353 K minus 273.15.

The text gives 5.07×10-4 S/cm for the highest-conductivity polymer in the training set, which the paper describes as the previously curated HTP-MD dataset computed from MD in refs [32, 10], so literature_cited is correct. No measurement temperature is stated for these training values, so null is right, and the unnamed polymer is identifiable from the paper's own description.
